title: Logo Don’ts
slide_intent: Identify unacceptable changes explicitly so local adaptations do not erode a recognizable shared mark.
strategic_value: A stable silhouette, lettering and color treatment can preserve Burger King recognition across partner executions.
demonstration: A three-by-three grid crosses out distortion, outlining, effects, tint changes, rotation, type substitution, missing words, missing buns and the previous logo.
practical_value: Reject altered logo constructions and outdated assets before release.

content_islands.name: Non-alteration rule
content_islands.spec: Place the rule and non-exhaustive-list note at left.

content_islands.name: Incorrect examples
content_islands.spec: Arrange nine crossed-out examples at right with a short error caption below each.

reference_purposes.Application: The labeled error grid supports checking a proposed logo execution.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source prohibits altering orientation, color or composition, extends the rules to wordmark and favicon, and says the examples are not exhaustive.

ingredient.name: Protected logo construction
ingredient.role: Preserve consistent identity through unchanged source assets.
ingredient.application: Do not distort, outline, add effects, recolor or fade, rotate, replace type, remove words or buns, or reuse the previous logo.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; restrictions include wordmark and favicon and are not limited to the nine illustrated mistakes.
